description: List/search patients in the practice, filterable by doctor, name, gender, date of birth, or last-modified time. Returns a page of patients plus `next`/`previous` URLs. DrChrono API: GET /patients.

date_of_birth.description: Filter by date of birth, yyyy-mm-dd.

gender.description: Filter by gender (e.g. Male, Female, Other, Unknown/Blank).

since.description: Return patients modified at/after this ISO timestamp (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00).

name: drchrono_list_patients
title: List patients
